name: code-map
description: Generate an interactive architectural map of any codebase — multi-language (Kotlin, Java, Python, Go, Rust, TypeScript/JavaScript, C, C++, C#, Swift, Objective-C, Dart, Lua), web-tree-sitter (WASM) powered, served on localhost. Requires a JS runtime (Node ≥18 or Bun); no Python.
